description: Assessment of the thermo-hydraulic properties of rock samples near Takhini Hot Springs and in the Tintina fault zone, Yukon is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Yukon | Gouvernement du Yukon. As part of an emerging program to understand ground temperature and geothermal heat potential in Yukon, the Yukon Geological Survey drilled two temperature gradient wells in south-central Yukon: one near the Takhini Hot Springs in 2017, and a second in the Tintina Trench in 2018. Coverage: Government of Yukon. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Yukon | Gouvernement du Yukon. Its tags are geothermal, ygs-import, ygs-import-20250711, ygs-publications, yukon-geological-survey. It offers 4 resource(s) in HTML, PDF, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-08-26 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Yukon. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
